Drivers.name: Hyperscaler capex
Drivers.thesis: Big-4 cloud capex funds most data center GPU demand; sustained growth extends NVIDIA's revenue runway, a cut shortens it.
Drivers.notes: Share of price left blank: needs the valuation work from a thesis session.

Drivers.name: Rubin ramp
Drivers.thesis: A smooth Rubin ramp keeps NVIDIA's product cadence ahead of custom silicon and protects pricing through the Blackwell-to-Rubin transition.
Drivers.notes: Mechanism: gross margin (D4) sits on it. Rubin share is not known to be disclosed; tracked as a Disclosure step (House Rule).

Drivers.name: Non-hyperscale demand
Drivers.thesis: Sovereign, enterprise and neocloud buyers diversify demand beyond the big 4 and reduce customer concentration.
Drivers.notes: Only measurable if NVIDIA splits Data Center revenue by customer type; otherwise narrative-only.

Drivers.name: Gross margin
Drivers.thesis: Margin holding near guidance through product transitions converts revenue growth into earnings.

Drivers.name: China (base case zero)
Drivers.thesis: Any resumption of meaningful data center sales to China is upside to a base case that assumes none.

Drivers.name: Balance sheet quality
Drivers.thesis: Inventory, receivables and supply commitments growing faster than revenue would signal demand pull-forward or financing risk.

Signals.name: Big-4 hyperscaler capex (AMZN+GOOG+MSFT+META), $B per calendar quarter
Signals.anchor: To set with the base case: consensus or each company's capex guidance; red where the combined path falls below the low end of guidance.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment per company. Trap: MSFT and AMZN also report finance leases; use one definition consistently and say which.

Signals.name: TSMC monthly revenue, YoY %
Signals.anchor: No consensus exists for monthly YoY; needs a Thesis row or an owner decision (shows GREY until then).
Signals.notes: Feed: TSMC monthly revenue release (~10th of each month). Broad AI and smartphone proxy, not NVIDIA-only.

Signals.name: Rubin share of Data Center revenue, %
Signals.anchor: Management commentary on the ramp; set once a figure is disclosed.
Signals.notes: Disclosure not confirmed. If the Q3 FY27 call passes without it, Scoring log Withheld = Y (RED) per House Rule.

Signals.name: Non-hyperscale Data Center revenue, $B
Signals.anchor: Set once NVIDIA's split is confirmed.
Signals.notes: Keep only if NVIDIA discloses a customer-type split; otherwise delete and D3 becomes narrative-only.

Signals.name: GAAP gross margin, %
Signals.anchor: Company guidance range (GAAP) and the guided trough; tolerance 2% of base, about 1.5 margin points, to be checked against the guidance band.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR GrossProfit / Revenues. Trap: guidance is given both GAAP and non-GAAP; secondary sources mix them. Use GAAP everywhere.

Signals.name: China data center export licence milestones
Signals.anchor: Base case is zero China data center revenue (company guidance assumption, to verify).

Signals.name: Inventory, $B
Signals.anchor: Thesis view: inventory growing faster than revenue for two quarters is the bear signal; base case from the prior quarter scaled by guided revenue growth.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR InventoryNet. No consensus exists: needs a Thesis row or an owner decision.

Signals.name: Days sales outstanding, days
Signals.notes: Computed: AccountsReceivableNetCurrent / Revenues x 91. No consensus exists.

Signals.name: Supply and purchase commitments, $B
Signals.anchor: Ratio to next-quarter revenue guide; the metric's own history.
Signals.notes: From the 10-Q commitments note (lead: reportedly rose sharply in Q2 FY27, mostly memory; unverified). Trap: definition may include multi-year cloud service agreements.

Event ladder.notes: No target date: base case expects no China data center revenue.

NVIDIA discloses Rubin share (or revenue) of Data Center at the Q3 FY27 earnings call
Event ladder.notes: Target date = the Q3 FY27 earnings date once confirmed (lead: 2026-11-17, unverified). If it passes without disclosure: Status = Failed and a Withheld row in the Scoring log.

Event ladder.milestone: NVIDIA discloses a hyperscale vs other split of Data Center revenue at the Q3 FY27 call
Event ladder.notes: Same date rule as the Rubin disclosure step.

Event ladder.milestone: Q3 FY27 GAAP gross margin lands inside the company's guided range
Event ladder.notes: Resolves at the Q3 FY27 print.

Event ladder.milestone: Thesis breaker: inventory grows faster than revenue for two consecutive quarters
Big-4 Q4 CY26 capex at or above the low end of each company's guidance
Event ladder.notes: Resolves with Q4 CY26 reports (late Jan to early Feb 2027).
